fr_html: Le PRESIDENT exprime l'avis qu'il vaut mieux en finir maintenant. Il donne de nouveau lecture du texte transactionnel proposé tout à l'heure.
en_html: The PRESIDENT expressed the opinion that it would be better to complete the matter now. He again read the compromise draft which he had just proposed.
